purpose: Teach: 住友/トルシエ/ディープインパクト/ホリデー/シューティング/師範/ラヴ/ボクサー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが住友銀行の口座を開設されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father opened an account at Sumitomo Bank.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight lift at the end like she's sharing news she thinks will please him. Calm, unhurried pace. The tone of a mother passing along something practical her child might find interesting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとトルシエ時代のサッカー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the old Troussier-era soccer matches with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush at the start. Quick tempo, words tumbling slightly over each other. Genuine excitement in the voice — he's bursting to share. Small pause before 'Dad' like he's proud of the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがディープインパクトの伝記をお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father bought himself a biography of Deep Impact.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost to herself. Slow, measured pace. A soft wondering in the tone — noticing a pattern, turning it over. No judgment, just quiet attention to the detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとホリデーに旅行行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go on a holiday trip with Dad!
lines.style: Open, hopeful intensity. Slight breathlessness — this is something he really wants. Direct eye contact in the voice. The eagerness of a child stating a simple, important desire.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがシューティングレンジに通われてるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, I hear your father's been going to the shooting range.
lines.style: Careful, almost hesitant. A slight question mark underneath — she's processing what this means. Quiet reflection. The pace is thoughtful, like she's choosing her words with precision.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと剣道師範のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me this amazing story about his kendo teacher!
lines.style: Animated and open. Quick tempo with warmth underneath. A child's genuine delight at having been trusted with a story. Small inflection lift on 'amazing' — he's proud of what he learned.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラヴソングのレコードを買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father bought a love songs record.
lines.style: Softer this time, almost tender. The pace slows slightly, becomes more introspective. There's something almost vulnerable in her delivery — she's noticing something shifting, something gentle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとプロボクサーのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched this documentary about a professional boxer together!
lines.style: Warm crescendo. Excitement building naturally through the line. The pride of shared experience — he's narrating a good memory. Slight lift at the very end, satisfied closure.
